failures.recovery: Inspect the installed query normalization and use a supported exact lexical selector; retain the zero-match receipt and do not change the catalogue or repeat its successful validation.

failures.rollback: Stop this query and retain all receipts; no caller or catalogue deletion.

failures.recovery: Discover each exact skill inventory before reading or invoking a helper. Preserve missing legacy availability if no installed callable exists and use the current owner-local preregistered structural guard without claiming the legacy helper was exercised.

failures.rollback: Stop unavailable helper selection; retain existing skills and all phase receipts.
